newsitem.title: USA: IMF lends Mali $28 mln for economic reforms.
newsitem.headline: IMF lends Mali $28 mln for economic reforms.

text.p: The International Monetary Fund said Monday it had approved a second annual loan of around $28 million for Mali's economic reforms this year under the Enhanced Structural Adjustment Facility.

It said Mali had made substantial progress under IMF-supported programs since 1992. The 1997 program is designed to boost real GDP by almost six percent, helped by good crops and the startup of a gold-mine. Inflation is to be cut to 3.5 percent and the external current account deficit to 11 percent of GDP from over 13 percent in 1996.

It said the Malian authorities would continue to pursue fiscal consolidation while ensuring adequate provision is made for spending in social sectors. However, it said Mali's economy remained fragile and so further progress was needed to improve the climate for private sector activity.
